deploy-bot: Preflight failed: release 20260322-08 blocked for service=embeddings. Env parity failure: PROD missing secret at path embeddings/api_key

deploy-bot: check details:
```
> check: secret-presence
> env: prod
> path: embeddings/api_key
> result: NOT_FOUND
> note: staging has value set: env.STAGING_EMBED_KEY exists
```

Maria: Ugh. I added the new embeddings feature flag and updated staging secrets yesterday. I forgot to sync the secret to prod when I added the feature flip. Sorry team. :disappointed: 

Ken: How risky is adding the secret now? Is it tied to a different KMS alias in prod?

Priya: It needs the prod KMS alias and paramstore entry. We can push the secret via the 3-step secured workflow but that's outside the 30m release window. If we hotpatch without the paramstore alias, embed calls will fail encryption/decryption.

Alex: Given call volume and SLAs on embeddings, I'd vote rollback + pin. Don't want to risk partial decryption errors in prod. Also audit what allowed this to land without the prod secret.

Maria: Agree rollback. I'll pin the image back to redwood/embeddings:2026-03-19-rc3. Command: `./ops/release pin --service embeddings --image redwood/embeddings:2026-03-19-rc3`

deploy-bot: Action: release 20260322-08 paused by Maria. To resume after manual fixes run `/release unpause 20260322-08` or create a replacement release with updated secrets.

Ken: I'll open a small PR that adds the missing secret mapping to the infra repo (https://github.com/redwood/infra-config/pull/999) and a note in the CHANGELOG. But we should not merge until infra confirms KMS alias mapping is in place.

Priya: I'll file an ops ticket for paramstore/KMS work: INF-7333 and assign to infra oncall. Also adding a deploycheck for secret presence for embeddings paths so deploybot blocks earlier next time.

Maria: PR and ticket sound good. I'll also add a brief release note: "Release paused due to missing PROD embeddings secret; rolled back to previous image; follow-up infra hotfix scheduled."

Alex: Rollback started to canary now. Keep an eye on embed latency graphs during revert.

deploy-bot: Rollback event: initiated by Maria at 2026-03-22T09:41:10Z. Canary health ok. Prod revert complete at 2026-03-22T09:46:05Z. Release remains paused pending INF-7333 and PR #999 verification.

Ken: PR #999 opened with secret mapping and a short note on why it was missing. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra-config/pull/999

Priya: INF-7333 created and assigned. I'll also schedule a 15-min sync with infra to confirm the paramstore alias will be available in next change window.

Maria: Thanks all. After infra confirms and we have the secret mapping merged, we can retest in staging and re-run the release. For now release 20260322-08 stays paused. :thumbsup:
